event_end.body.en: Time's up. Please check it off as done.

escalation.week_1.ko: [Schreduler] {subject}에 대해 1주째 응답이 없어요. 잘 지내고 계신가요?
escalation.week_1.en: [Schreduler] We haven't heard from you about {subject} for a week. How are you doing?

escalation.week_3.ko: [Schreduler] {subject}에 대해 3주째 응답이 없어 더 이상 알림을 보내지 않습니다. 다시 시작하고 싶으면 앱에서 아무 일정이나 완료 체크해주세요.
escalation.week_3.en: [Schreduler] We haven't heard from you about {subject} for 3 weeks, so we'll stop sending notifications. To start again, check off any event as done in the app.

sleep_checkin.body.ko: 어제 몇 시에 주무셨고 오늘 몇 시에 일어나셨나요?
sleep_checkin.body.en: What time did you go to bed last night, and when did you wake up today?
